1. चि चि, ii. 5, चिनु, Par. Ātm.

 संचित,

 --Cf. Lat. capio = Caus. चपयामि, capulus, capistrum; [] perhaps also κώπη and Goth. hafjan, hafan, hafts; A.S. hebban, thu hefest; Engl. to heave.

2. चि चि, ii. 5, चिनु, Par., Ātm.

 --With निस् निस्,
